place: The Hebden Bridge shop, 14 Mill Lane, Hebden Bridge HX7 8AB

job.title: Sales assistant
job.description: Serving customers at the till and on the shop floor, receiving deliveries and keeping the plant tables stocked.

probation.conditions: a review with the store manager at the end of the period; during it either side may end the employment with one week's notice

pay.paid: weekly, every Friday, for the week before
pay.method: bank transfer to the worker's account

components.name: Sunday premium
components.text: GBP 1.50 an hour on top for hours worked on a Sunday

hours.standard: 30 hours a week, Wednesday to Sunday, 10:00 to 16:30 with a 30-minute unpaid break
hours.overtime: extra hours only by agreement, paid at the basic rate
hours.shifts: a shift may be swapped with a colleague with the store manager's agreement

leave: 5.6 weeks' paid holiday a year, bank holidays included, in proportion to the hours worked. The holiday year runs from 1 January. Holiday pay is the normal pay for the hours that would have been worked, and holiday accrued but not taken is paid when the employment ends
sickness: Tell the store manager by 09:00 on the first day of absence. Statutory Sick Pay is paid from the first full day of sickness absence, at the statutory weekly rate or 80% of average weekly earnings if that is lower (from 6 April 2026, Employment Rights Act 2025 ss. 10 and 11); there is no company sick pay
pension: The worker is enrolled in the company's workplace pension scheme when eligible under the automatic enrolment rules
benefits: A 20 percent staff discount in the shop
termination: Either side ends the employment in writing. The worker gives one week's notice. The employer gives the notice section 86 of the Employment Rights Act 1996 sets out
training: Till and fire-safety training in the first two weeks, paid, required and at the employer's cost

disciplinary.rules: The staff handbook in the staff room and on the shared drive sets out the disciplinary rules
disciplinary.procedure: Disciplinary and dismissal decisions follow the procedure in the staff handbook, which follows the Acas Code of Practice on disciplinary and grievance procedures
disciplinary.appeal_to: the owner, Jane Holloway, in writing within five working days of the decision
disciplinary.grievance_to: the store manager, in writing; a grievance about the store manager goes to the owner
disciplinary.steps: a meeting within five working days of the appeal or grievance, then a written decision
